'''Schaum/Yfarg/Welbig/Fabrico and Associates''', better known as '''ShaumAssoc''', was an advertising agency and public relations firm. The company was owned by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leki]] interests and was headquartered on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]<ref name="HSCS" /> with offices on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Calocour Heights]].<ref name="CCW" /> They only dealt with major corporations, and as such had a consistent presence within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. When the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] was formed, ShaumAssoc became one of the original [[contributing sponsor]], and was then upgraded to [[voting sponsor]]. They were the creators of the CSA's media and public relations departments, and were surprisingly free of the restrictions the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] usually placed on media content.<ref name="HSCS" /> They were, at one point, contracted by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], and were subsequently responsible for the disastrous ''[[Blast Proof]]'' campaign.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Some believed that the company was involved in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] laundering for [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], but these allegations were never proven.<ref name="HSCS" />
